input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Sections 22.1-22.2 are the only provisions giving Vendor audit rights against us (Section 23 has no operative text and no other inspection, monitoring, or verification right binding Customer appears elsewhere). They meet every preferred element: audits limited to once in any twelve-month period, at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, off-site where practicable, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, with Vendor bearing costs unless the audit establishes underpayment exceeding five percent, and an express prohibition on Vendor or its auditor accessing Customer systems directly. Section 22.3 further protects us by making findings Customer Confidential Information. No redline is warranted.
